description: This is a Java source file defining the LogView class, which extends TextView and implements LogNode. The class formats log data and displays it in a UI component, also supporting chaining of log nodes for additional processing.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that formats and displays log messages received through the LogNode interface. Supports chaining with other LogNodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log message components and updates the UI log display. Also forwards the log message to the next LogNode if present.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
